items.title: Awesome Go
items.content_text:
### Audio and Music

*   [go-mpris (⭐19)](https://github.com/leberKleber/go-mpris) - Client for mpris dbus interfaces.

### Standard CLI

*   [structcli (⭐3)](https://github.com/leodido/structcli) - Eliminate Cobra boilerplate: build powerful, feature-rich CLIs declaratively from Go structs.

### Continuous Integration

*   [go-test-coverage](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/go-test-coverage) - A GitHub Action which reports issues when test coverage is below set threshold.

### Trees

*   [graphlib (⭐2)](https://github.com/aio-arch/graphlib) - Topological sort lib,Sorting and pruning of DAG graphs.

### Financial

*   [dec128 (⭐34)](https://github.com/jokruger/dec128) - High performance 128-bit fixed-point decimal numbers.

### Performance

*   [ebpf-go (⭐7.2k)](https://github.com/cilium/ebpf) - Provides utilities for loading, compiling, and debugging eBPF programs.

### Stream Processing

*   [StreamSQL (⭐46)](https://github.com/rulego/streamsql) - A lightweight streaming SQL engine for real-time data processing.

### Template Engines

*   [templator (⭐8)](https://github.com/alesr/templator) - A type-safe HTML template rendering engine for Go.

### Utilities

*   [rate (⭐157)](https://github.com/webriots/rate) - High-performance rate limiting library with token bucket and AIMD strategies.

items.title: Awesome Godot
items.content_text:
### Plugins and scripts / Godot 4

*   [Gedis (⭐74)](https://github.com/NodotProject/Gedis) - In-memory, Redis-like key-value store for Godot.
*   [GedisQueue (⭐3)](https://github.com/NodotProject/GedisQueue) - A comprehensive job queue system for Godot, backed by Gedis.
*   [Godot Torrent (⭐6)](https://github.com/NodotProject/godot-torrent) - A comprehensive BitTorrent GDExtension for Godot 4, providing full protocol functionality with native C++ performance.
*   [Netfox (⭐755)](https://github.com/foxssake/netfox) - Multiplayer timing, rollback and other multiplayer features.
*   [Nodot (⭐377)](https://github.com/NodotProject/nodot) - Node composition library for Godot 4.

### Plugins and scripts / Godot 3

*   [DungeonTemplateLibrary-Godot (⭐29)](https://github.com/krazyjakee/DungeonTemplateLibrary-Godot) - Godot Dungeon Template Library (terrain & roguelike generation).
*   [Vest (⭐15)](https://github.com/foxssake/vest) - A unit testing addon for Godot.

items.title: Awesome Neovim
items.content_text:
### Plugin Manager

*   [alyxshang/nuwa.nvim (⭐4)](https://github.com/alyxshang/nuwa.nvim) - A light Neovim package manager.

### AI / Diagnostics

*   [3ZsForInsomnia/code-companion-picker (⭐1)](https://github.com/3ZsForInsomnia/code-companion-picker) - Telescope and Snacks picker integrations for previewing CodeCompanion prompts.
*   [3ZsForInsomnia/vs-code-companion (⭐3)](https://github.com/3ZsForInsomnia/vs-code-companion) - Tool for importing VS Code's markdown prompts into CodeCompanion.
*   [3ZsForInsomnia/token-count.nvim (⭐1)](https://github.com/3ZsForInsomnia/token-count.nvim) - Shows the token count for the current buffer, with integrations for Lualine and NeoTree.

### Programming Languages Support / Diagnostics

*   [onlyati/quadlet-lsp.nvim (⭐5)](https://github.com/onlyati/quadlet-lsp.nvim) - Provides completion, hover and other language server features for Podman Quadlet files.

### Tree-sitter Supported Colorscheme / Diagnostics

*   [wurli/cobalt.nvim (⭐20)](https://github.com/wurli/cobalt.nvim) - A (mostly) faithful port of the classic blue theme from TextMate.
